title: Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now
why_it_matters: Anthropic quietly swapped Claude Code's runtime to Bun (the Rust-based JS runtime), a significant infrastructure move that signals where developer tooling performance is headed. Simon Willison's deep dive breaks down what changed and why it matters for CLI tool architecture.

title: OpenAI reduces Codex Model Context Size from 372k to 272k
why_it_matters: OpenAI quietly cut Codex's context window by 100k tokens — a rare regression that suggests real cost-performance trade-offs behind the scenes. Developers relying on long-context Codex workflows need to audit their pipelines now.

title: AI advice made people 3x less accurate but 2x confident, researchers found
why_it_matters: A new study quantifies a problem builders have suspected: AI assistance can suppress critical thinking, making users more confident while being dramatically less accurate. Anyone shipping user-facing AI features needs to read this before designing their trust signals.

title: Moonshot AI suspends new subscriptions due to Kimi K3 demand
why_it_matters: Follow-up: Kimi K3 demand is so intense that Moonshot AI has had to suspend new subscriptions entirely — a rare capacity-driven pause that validates K3's disruptive pricing and performance claims from earlier this week.

title: AI Mania Is Eviscerating Global Decision-Making
why_it_matters: Simon Willison's latest essay argues that AI hype is actively degrading decision-making quality at institutional scale — not just individual. A sober counterweight to the relentless optimism cycle, from one of the most credible voices in the space.

title: What to watch for after Jensen Huang's Japan visit
why_it_matters: Jensen Huang's Tokyo trip yielded deals spanning Japan's entire tech ecosystem — from data centers to automotive AI. The geopolitical implications for chip supply chains and NVIDIA's Asia strategy are significant for anyone building on NVIDIA infrastructure.

title: Can an Apple lawsuit derail OpenAI's hardware plans?
why_it_matters: Apple's lawsuit against OpenAI could have real consequences for OpenAI's hardware ambitions and IPO timeline. The Equity podcast debate surfaces the legal and strategic angles that most coverage has missed.

title: Dave Eggers told OpenAI staff that ChatGPT was 'silencing an entire generation'
why_it_matters: Sam Altman invited novelist Dave Eggers to address 200 OpenAI staffers — and Eggers delivered a blunt critique about AI's impact on creative development. The fact that OpenAI sought this out says something about the internal culture debate.

title: Neil Rimer thinks the AI money is coming back out
why_it_matters: Index Ventures co-founder Neil Rimer predicts the historic AI wealth concentration in Silicon Valley will face redistribution pressure — voluntary or not. A VC insider acknowledging this tension publicly is a notable signal for the industry's political trajectory.
